nodes.label: Close Icon (Red X Button)
nodes.description: A glossy red circular button with a white 'X' shape in the center, used as a UI icon to represent a close, dismiss, cancel, or remove action. Typical use cases include closing a tab, dialog, panel, or removing an item from a list.

nodes.label: Close/Dismiss Action
nodes.rationale: Represents the user-facing action of closing, cancelling, or removing an element. Red color signals destructive/exit semantics; X shape is a universal close affordance.
